title: AnitoDeployedReceipt
description: Deployment receipt written by Anito into .anito/deployed.json in the consuming repo after every successful deploy. Records every service this repo has registered with Anito — the authoritative local source for teardown, cleanup, and agent re-entry. Machine-written; do not edit by hand.

services.description: Map of service name → deployment entry. Keyed by service name (matches the name field of each entry).

name.description: Unique service name as registered with Anito. Use this name with anito_remove or anito teardown.

stable_port.description: The stable port consumers connect to. Owned by the Anito proxy — does not change across deploys.

binary_path.description: Absolute path to the binary or shell script that was deployed.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the .anito/config.yaml that produced this deploy.

version.description: Optional version tag: semantic version (v1.2.3) or content hash (sha:abc123).

deployed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent successful deploy.
